setting.help: Global Auditor used for all companies. Company-level Auditor remains only as a fallback for old records.

setting.string: Allow reset after approval route completion
setting.help: Allows Reset Approval after final Auditor approval. Odoo accounting locks and legal restrictions may still prevent Reset to Draft.

setting.string: Only the accountant/request owner can reset approval
setting.help: If disabled, the assigned Branch Manager, CEO, and Auditor can reset approval too.

setting.string: Reset approval when Reset to Draft is used
setting.help: Keeps approval status consistent when an authorized user resets the bill, invoice, or journal entry to draft.

setting.string: Require final Auditor review after posting
setting.help: For Branch/CEO routes, posted documents are forwarded to the Auditor for final review.
